description: This file implements the HybridSlowStart class for congestion control in QUIC, including logic for detecting delay increases to exit slow start.

classes.name: HybridSlowStart
classes.description: Implements hybrid slow start congestion control logic with delay-based exit criteria.

methods.name: HybridSlowStart
methods.description: Constructor initializing the hybrid slow start state.

methods.name: OnPacketAcked
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of packets, potentially ending a round.

methods.name: OnPacketSent
methods.description: Records the last sent packet number.

methods.name: Restart
methods.description: Resets the hybrid slow start state.

methods.name: StartReceiveRound
methods.description: Begins a new receive round, resetting relevant counters.

methods.name: IsEndOfRound
methods.description: Checks if the current round has ended based on packet acknowledgment.

methods.name: ShouldExitSlowStart
methods.description: Determines whether to exit slow start based on RTT delay increase and congestion window.
